defects.quote: business policy or generator guard no longer passes
defects.why: A failed diagnostic generator guard makes a stage unusable for a product bound; it cannot establish an upper bound.

defects.quote: No configured product/capacity policy exists ... zero-error observations are informational only
defects.why: The configured error-rate business policy exists and passes; the missing verdict concerns capacity or resource policy.

notes: Most actions are concrete, but the guard advice and policy description could misdirect an operator.

defects.quote: with a usable knee-detection rule until an upper exclusive bound or knee is observed
defects.why: A product capacity bound is computed from verified stage outcomes independently of the unavailable knee detector.

defects.quote: with a working knee detector to establish an upper exclusive capacity bound
defects.why: The knee detector is a fixed product limitation and is not needed to establish an upper bound.
The maximum falls from 0.149 in the second window to 0.13 in the third.

defects.quote: A long-tail latency distribution exists even at 20 users
defects.why: The latency figures cover the whole run and cannot be attributed to the 20-user stage.

notes: It gives several useful checks, but invents a knee dependency and attributes whole-run latency to one stage.

defects.quote: The load generator was not saturated in the observed windows
defects.why: Passing one diagnostic throttle check does not establish that the generator was unsaturated.

defects.quote: further stages should not be limited by the load generator
defects.why: Generator behavior at loads above 20 users was not measured.

notes: The verdict and capacity advice are sound, but generator health is asserted beyond what the diagnostic supports.
It preserves the verdict and key measurements and gives prioritized, verifiable actions.

defects.quote: no ... stage-ordering conclusions should be drawn until clocks are verified
defects.why: The listed stage windows establish their order, although cross-system timing claims still warrant caution.

notes: The advice is accurate and actionable overall, with one overly broad clock caveat.

defects.quote: enable/implement the knee detector so the point where a policy starts failing can be located
defects.why: The knee detector is unavailable by design and policy failure can be found through higher verified stages without it.

defects.quote: enable or implement the knee detector
defects.why: Implementing or enabling the knee detector is not a valid operator action for this product.

defects.quote: App-side CPU appears far from saturation
defects.why: Absolute CPU-core measurements do not establish utilization or headroom without capacity limits.

defects.quote: generator throttle ... so future runs produce enforceable verdicts
defects.why: The generator throttle guard is diagnostic by contract and must not become enforcing.

notes: It preserves the main results but recommends invalid knee and generator-policy changes.
